name: Agents only propose
description: Approve, reject, hold and release happen only on the Review step and the Payment gate.

name: Offline
description: The model runs on the local GPU. No cloud calls.

name: Sandbox
description: Agents read the inbox folder and write only to the results folder.

name: Quote check
description: Each quoted line is matched to the source file before it is shown.

name: Skeptic review
description: A second agent tries to disprove every finding. Always on, locked.

name: Audit trail
description: Every proposal, verdict and decision is logged with time and actor.
